design: Source-scoped entities and evidence-bearing assertions; project proposals and historical interpretations retain separate epistemic kinds.

entity_types.ActivityType: A category of work such as procurement, soaking or beating.
entity_types.ArchaeologicalObject: A distinguishable archaeological object; proposed function is not assumed by its class.
entity_types.Assemblage: A reported group of objects, including counts without separable identities.
entity_types.Community: A reported social group; not interchangeable with its settlement or every resident.
entity_types.ComparisonHypothesis: An interpretation or comparison with explicit scope/premises; not an observed causal fact.
entity_types.Concept: A source-scoped concept awaiting any more specific classification.
entity_types.DatingAssessment: An attributed dating statement with dated referent and basis, including unknown/conflicting assessments.
entity_types.DesignConcept: A reported design, motif or design category.
entity_types.EnvironmentContext: Reported environmental conditions or sourcing context.
entity_types.ExchangeRecord: An observed transaction or explicitly reported exchange practice, distinguished by scope.
entity_types.Feature: A morphological or contextual feature described by a source.
entity_types.FindContext: An excavation layer, recovery locality/context or contextual archaeological unit.
entity_types.LanguageVariety: An attributed language/variety identity, not inferred from a document's location alone.
entity_types.LinguisticAttestation: A sourced expression and proposed referent in a stated language/context.
entity_types.MaterialBatch: An identified batch/sample, distinct from its general material kind.
entity_types.Participant: An evidenced participant; anonymous speakers remain anonymous.
entity_types.Participation: Association of a participant or reported group with an activity and role.
entity_types.Place: A named locality or region as reported; precise coordinates require separately evidenced geometry.
entity_types.PlantTaxon: A reported botanical taxon; identification certainty is preserved.
entity_types.ProductionCase: A bounded account of an observed, habitual, recalled or secondary-reported production practice.
entity_types.ProjectTask: A project request/assignment; does not infer an accepted deadline or owner unless evidenced.
entity_types.RecoveryRecord: An attributed description of recovery, collection or museum observation.
entity_types.ReportedStage: An activity described within a production case; not necessarily a witnessed event.
entity_types.ResearchQuestion: A project question, not a statement that its proposed relationship is true.
entity_types.Role: A role description whose application is scoped to participation or a reported practice.
entity_types.SourceLead: A cited/retrieved reference candidate whose underlying original may remain unconsulted.
entity_types.TimeExpression: A raw or checked normalized period/date expression with conventions retained.
entity_types.ToolForm: A form/category of tools; does not identify a physical object.
entity_types.ToolInstance: An identified physical tool whose identity is evidenced.
entity_types.TypeCategory: A category within one typology scheme; codes are not globally equivalent.
entity_types.TypologyScheme: A classification belonging to a stated source or tradition.

aligns_reported_concept_with.definition: Provisional alignment of source-local generic concepts or reported names. Not physical identity, accepted taxonomic equivalence or historical transmission.

assigned_period.definition: Source's cultural-period attribution with contextual qualifiers.

attested_term_for.definition: Source reports a term referring to a concept in a stated linguistic context.

broader_category.definition: Source-local broader category; does not merge separate typology schemes.

calibration_status.definition: Explicit calibration convention or unknown status.

category_describes_tool_form.definition: Paper-local typology category describes forms within the reported tool-form terminology; no independent validation of tool function.

cites_source.definition: Citation/discovery lead; cited original is not presumed consulted.

compared_with.definition: A comparison made by a source; similarity does not establish identity or transmission.

dated_referent.definition: Identifies what the dating assessment concerns.

dating_basis.definition: Stated measurement, layer, phase, assemblage or analogy basis.

found_in_context.definition: Object/assemblage is reported in a specified recovery context.

has_activity.definition: Case includes a reported stage or work category.
has_activity.literal_definition: A literal preserves an attributed activity description from an uncertain secondary excerpt; it does not instantiate a witnessed stage or production case.

has_comparative_context.definition: Analyst-proposed comparison for a paper question; original sources did not necessarily make this comparison. Does not confirm archaeological function.

has_definition.definition: Source-local definition of a category, concept or scheme.

has_feature.definition: Attributed morphological or descriptive feature; uncertainty is retained.

has_participant_role.definition: Role scoped to participation or a reported production case.

has_related_concept_context.definition: Provisional comparison across differing concept granularity, taxonomic rank or tradition. Direction does not imply exact equivalence or automatic fact transfer.

has_reported_place_context.definition: Place named in the specific source account, with its exact attribution role retained. Not an inferred production place, findspot or coordinate.

identification_uncertain.definition: Source explicitly questions identity, classification or attribution.

located_in.definition: Source locates one spatial entity in another.
located_in.literal_definition: A literal preserves administrative or geographic wording exactly as reported, without claiming resolved modern boundaries or parent-place identity.

precedes_in_case.definition: Reported ordering within one production case; not a universal sequence.

processes_material.definition: Activity processes a reported material category/batch.

proposed_connection.definition: Attributed historical, geographical or linguistic connection hypothesis.

proposed_function.definition: Author/source function interpretation, never an automatic observation.

proposes_method.definition: Attributed method option/proposal, not a settled research result.

reported_alias.definition: Source associates labels; external/gazetteer identity still requires checking.

reported_at.definition: Source associates a record with a reported place.
reported_at.literal_definition: A literal preserves an attributed place/distribution description when distinct Place identities are unresolved; it never supplies coordinates.

reported_count.definition: Count whose scope distinguishes illustrated views/specimens and assemblage totals.

reported_date.definition: Raw attributed date/chronology attached to its assessment/context, not automatically a direct object date.

reported_dimensions.definition: Source measurement with units and dimensional labels where known.

reported_environment.definition: Environment attributed by a source; does not create a causal explanation by itself.

reported_exchange.definition: Source-reported exchange context or practice, not an invented transaction.

reported_material.definition: Material attributed by the source, without unreported mineral/taxon specificity.

reported_recovery.definition: Attributed recovery/collection status or event description.

reported_season.definition: Seasonality stated by a source; unknown stays unknown.

requests_information.definition: Project request for information, not a domain fact.

source_classifies_as_tool_form.definition: Source-explicit terminology or form classification for a described object, preserving disputed function.

states_limitation.definition: Source or project states an evidential/methodological limitation.

uses_design.definition: Reported application of a design in a production context.

uses_tool.definition: Reported use of an identified physical tool in a scoped case.

uses_tool_form.definition: Reported use of a tool form in a scoped case.

status: source-scoped graph with explicitly provisional paper-seeded alignment layer
